title: My Last Dream In Mall World.
content: I had this dream back in 2023. I was in my old house/neighborhood from when I was a child. Also every time I’m in mall world I somehow always know it’s a dream and I’m always scared someone’s going to call me out so I’m constantly on the go. When I walked out of my childhood home and into the neighborhood it was like Halloween was happening, everyone was outside trick or treating except for this one house. This house is huge and grey. I always feel icky when I’m around this house and for some reason I felt the need to go inside. I get teleported again - this time it’s in an apartment and everything in this apartment from the ceiling to the carpet was red. I had this urge to get out of the apartment as quick as I could. I remember not knowing who the people in the costumes were in that apartment and they were trying to get me to stay and I just couldn’t get myself to stay I felt like I was in danger. I ended up escaping and I was so frightened at the fact that the staircase to the apartment was red also. Once I started walking around the town trying to find my way back to the house, I just remember being so amazed at the structure and colors of these apartments. The apartments were stacked on top of each other and some of the apartments were stacked on top of popular restaurants and bars. It was like the apartments were made out of clay and were yellow and rust brown colors. I had been to other apartment/condo complexes before from my childhood but this was a whole new town that just kept getting more and more dangerous the more I explored around. I ended up running into people I know (allegedly) and they were trying to look for a party (?) once they started walking me towards this party I had realized the entire building was on fire and no one noticed but me. That alone freaked me out more that I knew it was on fire and no one else knew. I was pressured into the building and while I was walking around I felt like someone was following me. Once I tried to escape the building multiple people were following me including “a friend” I had in that world. I ended up teleporting again and this time I was hiding behind the desk at a hotel. The lights were dim, it was a calmer environment however the man at the desk seemed to know who I was and seemed to have some romantic connection to me, I’m not too sure, but he definitely knew I knew this was a dream. He ended up helping me hide for a while until someone told him to escort me out because I had been caught. I haven’t had a mall world dream since. Ps, I’ve also experienced this overwhelming depressing feeling of a parking garage late at night that I get stuck on and it snows too. I’ve also experienced getting lost in a movie theater and museum. I’ve also experienced and witnessed a bunch of crime in certain areas.
